newsitem.title: USA: Access in development pact with Dow.
newsitem.headline: Access in development pact with Dow.

text.p: Access Pharmaceuticals Inc Wednesday said it has signed a pact with Dow Chemical Co to develop products incorporating Dow's chelation technology and Access' bioresponsive polymer systems.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed. But Access said it will grant Dow an equity position, in the company, as well as manufacturing rights and future royalty payments.

Access will receive an exclusive license for the use of the chelation technology in conjunction with its polymers for MRI (magnetic resonance imaging) contrast agents, radiopharmaceutical diagnostics and therapeutics.
The advancement of the Access developments in these areas are dependent on securing chelation technology, which encapsulates metals to avoid adverse effects in the body, Access said.
